title: Python: observed peer and queue-service metrics
description:
Update CCP2 use of python/src/lichen/ccp.py samplers and event hooks in python/src/lichen/link/link_layer.py and python/src/lichen/link/tx_queue.py. Count distinct immediate radio peers, retain observation coverage/uncertainty, and age windows independently of RX. Keep local TX airtime, observed channel busy time, CCA deferrals, queue age/service and directional delivery evidence separate. Do not add synthetic neighbors for weak RSSI or loss.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Existing BusyPercentSampler, PacketErrorPermilleTracker and PeerDensityTracker are reuse foundations for b7z9.29, not absent code. Preserve explicitly legacy tests while adding independent CCP2 cases. Avoid a new metrics framework or feedback controller. This leaf observes existing queues and custody service without altering eviction, TTL, retries, identity ownership, baseline SCHC or security.
acceptance_criteria: Consume vectors.07 through production samplers and event hooks. Cover duplicate direct peers, relayed origins, weak RSSI/loss with unchanged peer count, many idle versus few busy peers, off-channel/sleep coverage, silence while admission is suppressed and timer-only expiration. Verify retained control-density and adaptive-duty boundaries without channel/SF changes. TX completion cannot supply packet delivery or loss evidence. Extend python/tests/test_ccp.py and focused LinkLayer/queue tests; run pytest and ruff.
